Everything below was read off datasheet.pdf IN THIS FOLDER (fetched 2026-09-02, sha256 b1f1b492ee36fe4bcaf094ded4c058daadd92f5ca423b7c1b7b774458aa5ccfa, PROVENANCE.json) via `pdftotext -layout`; quotes are that extraction with whitespace collapsed, and tools/datasheet-quotes-check.py re-finds every one of them in the PDF.
record.description: Protection IC for a 2-serial-cell lithium-ion / lithium-polymer pack: per-cell overcharge / overdischarge detection, discharge overcurrent, load short, optional charge overcurrent; drives two external N-FETs (DO discharge gate, CO charge gate) in the pack's negative leg; VM pin senses the load/charger. p.1 verbatim (whitespace collapsed): 'The S-8252 Series is a protection IC for 2-serial-cell lithium-ion / lithium polymer rechargeable batteries and includes high- accuracy voltage detection circuits and delay circuits.'
record.description_quote: The S-8252 Series is a protection IC for 2-serial-cell lithium-ion / lithium polymer rechargeable batteries and includes high- accuracy voltage detection circuits and delay circuits.

record.rails_why: not a rail-powered chip: VDD is the top of the 2S stack, VSS its bottom, VC the mid-tap. It draws from the cells it protects.

Power dissipation 650 mW (SOT-23-6) / 400 mW (SNT-6A) 'when mounted on board' per the table's *1 note (JEDEC STANDARD51-7 board).

current_mA.rail_basis: drawn from the protected stack (VDD–VSS), not from a system rail.
current_mA.typical_basis: Electrical Characteristics row verbatim: 'Current consumption during operation IOPE V1 = V2 = 3.5 V, V3 = 0 V − 4.0 8.0 μA 2' — 4.0 µA typ. A second variant table prints 4.5 / 8.5 µA; the first table's figure is carried here and the difference is in unknowns.
current_mA.peak_basis: same row, MAX column 8.0 µA — the steady-state maximum, not a transient. p.1 Features: 'During operation: 8.0 μA max. (Ta = +25°C)'.
current_mA.sleep_basis: p.1 Features 'During power-down: 0.1 μA max. (Ta = +25°C)' — a MAX, not a typical; the power-down function is a per-variant option ('Available, unavailable').

caveats: Two Electrical Characteristics tables exist (variants differ); IOPE prints 4.0/8.0 µA in one and 4.5/8.5 µA in the other. The variant chosen fixes which applies.

example_variant_for_a_4p2V_per_cell_pack.reading: p.3 '3. Product name list' row for S-8252AAL-M6T1U. Column order READ OFF THE TABLE HEADER (p.3 'Table 2 (1 / 2)', extracted lines 128-134, whitespace collapsed): 'Product Name', 'Overcharge Detection Voltage [VCU]', 'Overcharge Release Voltage [VCL]', 'Overdischarge Detection Voltage [VDL]', 'Overdischarge Release Voltage [VDU]', 'Discharge Overcurrent Detection Voltage [VDIOV]', 'Load Short-circuiting Detection Voltage [VSHORT]', 'Charge Overcurrent Detection Voltage [VCIOV]', '0 V Battery Charge', 'Power-down Function', 'Delay Time Combination*1'. So for S-8252AAL-M6T1U: VCU 4.200 V, VCL 4.050 V, VDL 2.500 V, VDU 3.000 V, VDIOV 0.200 V, VSHORT 0.500 V, VCIOV −0.200 V, 0 V charge Inhibited, power-down Available, delay combination (1). An overcharge detection of 4.200 V/cell is the ceiling a 4.2 V Li-ion cell is charged to; NOT chosen here — a design chooses its variant against the cell's own datasheet, which this shelf does not have (part:np-f550 unknowns).

unknowns: WHICH VARIANT. The S-8252 is a family; the detection voltages are fixed per suffix (p.3-4 product name list). No variant is chosen here because the cell inside the Microduck's NP-F550 pack is unidentified (part:np-f550) — a 4.20 V/cell variant such as S-8252AAL-M6T1U is shown as an EXAMPLE only.
THE AMPERE THRESHOLDS. Overcurrent detection is a VM-pin voltage (0.050–0.400 V); the current it corresponds to is that voltage over the two external FETs' RDS(on) and is not a datasheet figure.
DELAY TIMES were not transcribed (p.1: 'Detection delay times are generated only by an internal circuit (external capacitors are unnecessary). Accuracy ±20%').
SNT-6A pinout not transcribed (Table 7); only SOT-23-6 is here.
Two Electrical Characteristics tables (variant groups) print slightly different IOPE (4.0/8.0 vs 4.5/8.5 µA); the first is carried.
